style_rules.rule: Every page must be reachable by links from the first page. Groups of pages that only link to each other count as unreachable.
Setup steps must work for a buyer on any purchase date in the selling window, for example before the dated year starts. Walk through day one for an early buyer and a mid-year buyer.
Every number or fact in the listing (pages, file size, what is and isn't included) must match the built file. Rebuilds change counts; update the copy.
Use only glyphs the embedded fonts contain. Draw arrows and icons as SVG, otherwise a non-licensed fallback font gets embedded.
A listing photo must show what its copy and alt text claim. A small multi-page grid needs captions and readable pages (2x2 beats 4 in a row).
No half-empty pages. Fill spare space with something a buyer uses (a map of the top bar, a month jump grid, a pen test area), never decoration.
Never promise service levels in the product (for example 'we reply fast'). Say what the buyer can do instead.
A week that spans two months is built once, under the month that holds its Thursday; day pages name their own month in the trail.
Spreadsheets: never rely on a feature Google Sheets drops on import (data bars, Excel-only functions, external-style '#Sheet' links). Use text bars, functions both apps share, and internal tab links.
Every input cell must change at least one result. An input that nothing reads is a broken promise.
style_rules.from: coverage check, Clear Budget round 1 (Debt 'Extra each month')

style_rules.rule: Size every list for the worst real case (weekly pay has 53 paydays a year; a month can hold 80+ purchases), or say plainly where it stops.
Only input cells are shaded. Labels, totals and formulas are never shaded like inputs.
Listing photos must be readable at Etsy's zoom: show the useful part of a page or tab, large, never a whole page shrunk to fit. Alt text and points describe only what is in frame.
Start-up steps cover a buyer who buys before the product's year starts (Oct to Dec) as well as one who buys mid-year.

Price inside the market's best-earning range, never under it: at least the revenue-weighted median price (what buyers actually pay, weighted by sales). A low price makes a good product look cheap. While the shop has few reviews, launch with a time-limited Etsy sale (25% off for 30 days) on the full price instead of a low price.
style_rules.from: Darren and Colynne, Oct 22 2026 (Canva course advice, confirmed by our price data)

style_rules.rule: At most two font families per product: one for headings, one for body. Build hierarchy with weight, size and italic, not extra typefaces. Too many fonts tires the eyes.
style_rules.from: Colynne's review of p-rjd-001, Oct 23 2026 (fix: fonts)
